PRIYA SINHA Business Analyst | Trade Lifecycle, Platform Migration & Transformation | BlackRock Aladdin | Securities Operations, Reconciliation & SWIFT Payments Pune, Maharashtra, India | +918862089782 | pihusinha.1095@gmail.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Results-driven Business Analyst / Investment Banking Operations professional with 8+ years of experience across Securities Operations, Trade Settlement, Custody Transitions, End-to-End Trade Lifecycle Management, Trade Surveillance, and Trade & Cash SWIFT Payments, with hands-on experience on the BlackRock Aladdin platform for trade booking, validation, confirmation, and portfolio and trade management. Experienced in partnering with Product Managers, business stakeholders, and operational SMEs to define platform capabilities, business requirements, and target operating models for middle- and back-office functions, and in supporting large-scale system migration and platform-transformation initiatives, including current-state analysis, gap assessments, process mapping, data mapping, reconciliation planning, and business readiness. Skilled in translating complex business processes into user stories with clear acceptance criteria and functional specifications, facilitating refinement sessions across business and technology stakeholders, and operating within Agile/Scrum/Sprint delivery frameworks using JIRA and Confluence. Comfortable coordinating testing activities through the SDLC, supporting data validation, reconciliation, and migration cutover planning, and working within defined control frameworks and standard operating procedures across US, UK, and APAC markets.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Business Analysis & Requirements Gathering • Functional & Non-Functional Requirements • Target Operating Model Design • Platform Migration & Transformation Programs • Gap Assessment & Process Mapping (AS-IS/TO-BE) • Data Mapping & Reconciliation Planning • Business Readiness & Change Management • User Stories, Acceptance Criteria & Functional Specifications • Agile / Scrum / Sprint Framework (JIRA, Confluence) • Stakeholder Management (Product, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Technology) • BlackRock Aladdin Platform (Trade Booking, Validation, Confirmation, Portfolio & Risk Management) • End-to-End Trade Lifecycle Management (Equity, Fixed Income, Repo, Derivatives, FX, Securities Financing) • Trade Surveillance & Exception Monitoring • Trade & Cash SWIFT Payments (MT103, MT202, MT540–MT543) • SmartStream Reconciliation • Bloomberg Terminal • SLA & TAT Monitoring • Data Integrity & Transaction Reporting • Internal Audits & High-Volume QC • Client Onboarding & Compliance Controls • Corporate Actions • Team Leadership & Training

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Business Analyst – Payments, Securities & Settlement Operations Cognizant Technology Solutions Pvt Ltd | Pune, India

Jul 2023 – Oct 2025

Partnered with Product Managers, business stakeholders, and operational SMEs to define platform capabilities, business requirements, and target operating models for Restructure/Transitions activity across middle- and back-office functions. ● Held full ownership of Restructure/Transitions processes, reports, and procedures, ensuring quality and accuracy of end-to- end trade lifecycle processing and reporting outputs within predefined guidelines.



Supported current-state analysis, gap assessments, process mapping, data mapping, and reconciliation planning for Restructure/Transitions events across Equity, Fixed Income, Repo, and Derivatives, reviewing outputs against expected results and escalating discrepancies for timely resolution.

Worked on the BlackRock Aladdin platform for trade booking, validation, and transaction processing in support of Restructure/Transitions activity, ensuring accurate processing and reconciliation of trade data against portfolio and settlement records.

Performed trade surveillance and exception monitoring on trade and settlement activity, identifying unusual breaks, mismatches, and out-of-tolerance items and escalating for review in line with control and compliance requirements.



Logged, prioritized, and tracked Restructure/Transitions deliverables and enhancement requests using JIRA, contributing to sprint refinement and operating within an Agile/Scrum delivery cadence alongside Operations and Technology teams. ● Booked Foreign Exchange (FX) deals for funding and repatriation of underlying trades, applying working knowledge of

investment markets and instruments including Equity, Bonds, FX, and Derivatives.

Processed and authorized SWIFT MT operational messaging (MT103, MT200, MT202, MT210, MT540–MT543), supporting accurate, timely trade and cash settlement, funding operations, and custodial operations.

● Performed reconciliation of trade, cash, securities, and general ledger positions using SmartStream and Bloomberg, identifying breaks and control gaps and coordinating remediation with Investment Managers, Fund Groups, and custodian teams to maintain data accuracy and reporting integrity.

● Monitored trade and payment processing against defined SLA and turnaround-time (TAT) targets, tracking exceptions and

driving timely closure to maintain 100% adherence to client and regulatory deadlines.

Acted as liaison between Trading desk, Investment Managers, and Agent/Custodian Banks, gathering and clarifying operational requirements, documenting resolutions via the Inquiry Management Tool (IMT), and escalating issues to the Research & Resolution Team — providing structured stakeholder support comparable to representing business-unit requirements in cross-functional review forums.

Performed client onboarding checks, static data verification, and signature/callback authentication on high-risk instructions, applying compliance-driven controls to support regulatory and operational standards.

Conducted high-volume QC checks and internal audits, identifying and resolving low-to-moderate complexity issues within established guidelines — experience directly transferable to review-and-challenge of centrally produced reporting outputs.

Prepared and reviewed trade documentation and query logs, and produced formal MIS reports supporting requirement clarity, traceability, and transparency for downstream operations and technology teams.

Established and maintained quality-control processes for securities and payment operations, monitoring production against productivity, accuracy, and SLA/TAT metrics.

Built working relationships with off-shore partners, trained new and existing staff, and led onboarding/knowledge-sharing programs to strengthen team capability, controls awareness, and process consistency.

Business Analyst – Capital Markets Payments Operations (Deutsche Bank Client) Foray Sokware Pvt Ltd | Pune, India

Nov 2021 – Sep 2022

Worked in a Business Analyst capacity on end-to-end trade lifecycle and payment operations workflows for a Deutsche Bank (DB) capital markets payments engagement, liaising directly with business, risk, and operations stakeholders to capture requirements for International Cash Payment and trade-related SWIFT processes.

Translated business requirements into clear functional specifications and process documentation, supporting downstream technology teams in building and testing solutions.



Supported trade surveillance and control-gap analysis on payment and settlement workflows, monitoring exceptions against SLA and turnaround-time (TAT) targets and flagging risk items for remediation.

Conducted AS-IS and TO-BE process analysis for cash payment and trade operations, performing gap assessments and preparing workflow charts and diagrams to document current-state and target-state processes.



Identified problems and risks in existing operational methodologies and implemented controls and process modifications aligned to compliance and operational standards, supporting remediation of process deficiencies.

Used Bloomberg and SmartStream reference data and reconciliation outputs to validate payment and trade instructions and support root-cause analysis of recurring exceptions.



Logged and tracked operational tickets, user stories, and tasks in JIRA within an Agile/Scrum/Sprint framework, and maintained workflow documentation and process notes in Confluence to ensure transparent, auditable process governance.

Defined project phases and milestones and coordinated project teams to execute deliverables within scope, budget, and agreed SLA commitments.

Performed daily, weekly, and monthly reviews of operational metrics and reports, and prepared technical reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing operational information for senior management review.

Published progress reports and recommended actionable process changes to senior management, using data analysis to support recommendations and participating in implementation of approved changes.

Senior Associate – Trade Confirmation, Settlement & SWIFT Operations State Street Syntel Pvt Ltd | Pune, India

Mar 2017 – Sep 2021

Performed Trade Confirmation for Buy and Sell trades across the end-to-end trade lifecycle, verifying trade details against client and counterparty instructions and confirming matched trades on accounting and custody platforms prior to settlement.

Processed Buy and Sell trades, Cash, FX, and SWIFT transactions as part of the Screening team, verifying and routing US and non-US instructions to the correct processing team within SLA deadlines, operating under strict quality and control standards.

Carried out trade surveillance activities on daily trade and settlement queues, monitoring for anomalies, unmatched trades, and control breaches and escalating per risk and compliance procedures.

Performed signature verification and callbacks on high-risk instructions with clients, Investment Managers, and Fund Groups to prevent fraudulent activity, applying documented control procedures.

Reviewed, verified, confirmed, and authorized trades on accounting and custody platforms as part of the Quality team, amending trades per client requirements — direct experience in structured second-line review and challenge of processed outputs.

● Documented recurring settlement issues and process observations as structured tickets and improvement items, supporting

later adoption of Agile/Scrum tracking practices (JIRA) in subsequent Business Analyst roles.

Processed Trade-related SWIFT instructions (MT540–MT543), Cash-related SWIFT instructions (MT200, MT202, MT304, MT380), and Free Format SWIFT instructions (MT599, MT299).

Handled cash receipts, transfers, and payments across accounting and custody, including FX processing and authorization, and monitored and controlled the settlement queue against SLA and turnaround-time (TAT) targets.

Reconciled trade and cash positions using SmartStream and Bloomberg data feeds to identify and resolve breaks in support of accurate end-to-end trade lifecycle processing.

Cross-trained across the Research & Resolution Team (RRT), Right Fax (German client desk), and TASK (client escalation resolution), broadening cross-functional process knowledge and stakeholder coordination skills.

Worked extensively on the BlackRock Aladdin platform for trade booking, validation, and confirmation across portfolio and trade management activities, prioritizing urgent instructions (FED, Repo, IPO, off-currency) across multiple business units and global stakeholder groups.

EDUCATION

B.Com – Indira College of Commerce and Science, Pune, India ● HSC – Kendriya Vidyalaya No. 1, Dehu Road (CBSE), Pune, India ● SSC – Kendriya Vidyalaya No. 1, Dehu Road (CBSE), Pune, India

TECHNICAL SKILLS

BlackRock Aladdin (Trade Booking, Validation & Confirmation) • JIRA (Agile/Scrum, Sprint Planning, Backlog & Ticket Tracking) • Confluence (Requirements & Process Documentation) • SmartStream (Reconciliation) • Bloomberg Terminal • GTM • Instruct Lite • PeopleSoft • MCH • IMT • Fax Server • Test Key • MYSS • Right Fax • MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint). Working exposure to Agile/Scrum delivery methodology, user story writing & acceptance criteria, automation-oriented QC and workflow tools, trade surveillance monitoring, and SLA/TAT reporting within a Securities Operations environment.

AWARDS & RECOGNITION

Titan Award (Twice) ●

Spot Recognition for outstanding efforts during high-volume periods

Appreciation Award for State Street hyper-care client roleplay ● Team Champ Award for exceptional performance

LANGUAGES

English, Hindi, Marathi, Garo

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Business Analyst – Payments, Securities & Settlement Operations Cognizant Technology Solutions Pvt Ltd | Pune, India
Jul 2023 – Oct 2025
Partnered with Product Managers, business stakeholders, and operational SMEs to define platform capabilities, business requirements, and target operating models for Restructure/Transitions activity across middle- and back-office functions. ● Held full ownership of Restructure/Transitions processes, reports, and procedures, ensuring quality and accuracy of end-to- end trade lifecycle processing and reporting outputs within predefined guidelines.

Supported current-state analysis, gap assessments, process mapping, data mapping, and reconciliation planning for Restructure/Transitions events across Equity, Fixed Income, Repo, and Derivatives, reviewing outputs against expected results and escalating discrepancies for timely resolution.
Worked on the BlackRock Aladdin platform for trade booking, validation, and transaction processing in support of Restructure/Transitions activity, ensuring accurate processing and reconciliation of trade data against portfolio and settlement records.
Performed trade surveillance and exception monitoring on trade and settlement activity, identifying unusual breaks, mismatches, and out-of-tolerance items and escalating for review in line with control and compliance requirements.

Logged, prioritized, and tracked Restructure/Transitions deliverables and enhancement requests using JIRA, contributing to sprint refinement and operating within an Agile/Scrum delivery cadence alongside Operations and Technology teams. ● Booked Foreign Exchange (FX) deals for funding and repatriation of underlying trades, applying working knowledge of
investment markets and instruments including Equity, Bonds, FX, and Derivatives.
Processed and authorized SWIFT MT operational messaging (MT103, MT200, MT202, MT210, MT540–MT543), supporting accurate, timely trade and cash settlement, funding operations, and custodial operations.
● Performed reconciliation of trade, cash, securities, and general ledger positions using SmartStream and Bloomberg, identifying breaks and control gaps and coordinating remediation with Investment Managers, Fund Groups, and custodian teams to maintain data accuracy and reporting integrity.
● Monitored trade and payment processing against defined SLA and turnaround-time (TAT) targets, tracking exceptions and
driving timely closure to maintain 100% adherence to client and regulatory deadlines.
Acted as liaison between Trading desk, Investment Managers, and Agent/Custodian Banks, gathering and clarifying operational requirements, documenting resolutions via the Inquiry Management Tool (IMT), and escalating issues to the Research & Resolution Team — providing structured stakeholder support comparable to representing business-unit requirements in cross-functional review forums.
Performed client onboarding checks, static data verification, and signature/callback authentication on high-risk instructions, applying compliance-driven controls to support regulatory and operational standards.
Conducted high-volume QC checks and internal audits, identifying and resolving low-to-moderate complexity issues within established guidelines — experience directly transferable to review-and-challenge of centrally produced reporting outputs.
Prepared and reviewed trade documentation and query logs, and produced formal MIS reports supporting requirement clarity, traceability, and transparency for downstream operations and technology teams.
Established and maintained quality-control processes for securities and payment operations, monitoring production against productivity, accuracy, and SLA/TAT metrics.
Built working relationships with off-shore partners, trained new and existing staff, and led onboarding/knowledge-sharing programs to strengthen team capability, controls awareness, and process consistency.
Business Analyst – Capital Markets Payments Operations (Deutsche Bank Client) Foray Sokware Pvt Ltd | Pune, India
Nov 2021 – Sep 2022
Worked in a Business Analyst capacity on end-to-end trade lifecycle and payment operations workflows for a Deutsche Bank (DB) capital markets payments engagement, liaising directly with business, risk, and operations stakeholders to capture requirements for International Cash Payment and trade-related SWIFT processes.
Translated business requirements into clear functional specifications and process documentation, supporting downstream technology teams in building and testing solutions.

Supported trade surveillance and control-gap analysis on payment and settlement workflows, monitoring exceptions against SLA and turnaround-time (TAT) targets and flagging risk items for remediation.
Conducted AS-IS and TO-BE process analysis for cash payment and trade operations, performing gap assessments and preparing workflow charts and diagrams to document current-state and target-state processes.

Identified problems and risks in existing operational methodologies and implemented controls and process modifications aligned to compliance and operational standards, supporting remediation of process deficiencies.
Used Bloomberg and SmartStream reference data and reconciliation outputs to validate payment and trade instructions and support root-cause analysis of recurring exceptions.

Logged and tracked operational tickets, user stories, and tasks in JIRA within an Agile/Scrum/Sprint framework, and maintained workflow documentation and process notes in Confluence to ensure transparent, auditable process governance.
Defined project phases and milestones and coordinated project teams to execute deliverables within scope, budget, and agreed SLA commitments.
Performed daily, weekly, and monthly reviews of operational metrics and reports, and prepared technical reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing operational information for senior management review.
Published progress reports and recommended actionable process changes to senior management, using data analysis to support recommendations and participating in implementation of approved changes.
Senior Associate – Trade Confirmation, Settlement & SWIFT Operations State Street Syntel Pvt Ltd | Pune, India
Mar 2017 – Sep 2021
Performed Trade Confirmation for Buy and Sell trades across the end-to-end trade lifecycle, verifying trade details against client and counterparty instructions and confirming matched trades on accounting and custody platforms prior to settlement.
Processed Buy and Sell trades, Cash, FX, and SWIFT transactions as part of the Screening team, verifying and routing US and non-US instructions to the correct processing team within SLA deadlines, operating under strict quality and control standards.
Carried out trade surveillance activities on daily trade and settlement queues, monitoring for anomalies, unmatched trades, and control breaches and escalating per risk and compliance procedures.
Performed signature verification and callbacks on high-risk instructions with clients, Investment Managers, and Fund Groups to prevent fraudulent activity, applying documented control procedures.
Reviewed, verified, confirmed, and authorized trades on accounting and custody platforms as part of the Quality team, amending trades per client requirements — direct experience in structured second-line review and challenge of processed outputs.
● Documented recurring settlement issues and process observations as structured tickets and improvement items, supporting
later adoption of Agile/Scrum tracking practices (JIRA) in subsequent Business Analyst roles.
Processed Trade-related SWIFT instructions (MT540–MT543), Cash-related SWIFT instructions (MT200, MT202, MT304, MT380), and Free Format SWIFT instructions (MT599, MT299).
Handled cash receipts, transfers, and payments across accounting and custody, including FX processing and authorization, and monitored and controlled the settlement queue against SLA and turnaround-time (TAT) targets.
Reconciled trade and cash positions using SmartStream and Bloomberg data feeds to identify and resolve breaks in support of accurate end-to-end trade lifecycle processing.
Cross-trained across the Research & Resolution Team (RRT), Right Fax (German client desk), and TASK (client escalation resolution), broadening cross-functional process knowledge and stakeholder coordination skills.
Worked extensively on the BlackRock Aladdin platform for trade booking, validation, and confirmation across portfolio and trade management activities, prioritizing urgent instructions (FED, Repo, IPO, off-currency) across multiple business units and global stakeholder groups.
